The vendor directly providing **OnChat** (at **`onchat.ai`**) is **Soldigo SRL**.

### Evidence
* According to the official **Terms and conditions** on `onchat.ai` (Section 18.7): 
  > *"Soldigo Srl (OnChat) is a company registered in Romania."*
* Official marketplace listings (such as the Shopify App Store) also identify the developer and support provider for OnChat as **Soldigo SRL** (Str. Piața Libertății nr. 10, Miercurea Ciuc, Romania).
